purpose: Define what evidence is required before Pineland may estimate or freeze a quantitative latent-to-recorded historical observation operator for control, presence, access, or governance constructs.
scientific_firewall: Historical predictive outcomes may not be used to choose measurement-error parameters.
Model latent values may not be inspected to choose source error rates, spatial aggregation rules, thresholds, or source-family weights.
Coder agreement measures coding reproducibility; it is not a source truth/accuracy estimate.
Multiple rows extracted from one article, publisher pipeline, or republication chain do not count as independent source replication.
A missing or inaccessible source document is not silently treated as verified evidence.

evidence_classes.direct_measurement: A source directly reports the target construct at an explicit or bounded place/time.
evidence_classes.proxy: A source reports a related quantity requiring an explicit construct mapping.
evidence_classes.narrative: Contextual or interpretive evidence not suitable for direct likelihood contribution.
evidence_classes.model_output: Pineland latent or recorded state; never an independent empirical source.

source_independence.unit: originating information pipeline, not URL or article count
rules: Syndication/republication does not create a new independent family.
A report quoting another named outlet inherits dependence on the originating outlet for the quoted claim.
Multiple observations from the same source document are clustered within that document.
Multiple documents from the same institution are not automatically independent when they share the same collection pipeline.

source_detection.estimand: P(source emits an admissible observation | compatible latent construct exists)
source_detection.identification_requirement: replicated compatible cells with a defensible reference/overlap design; event absence in a source alone is not a false negative

source_false_positive.estimand: P(source emits the construct | compatible latent construct absent)
source_false_positive.identification_requirement: independent reference evidence or a separately validated latent-negative sample

actor_attribution.estimand: P(reported actor | true actor, source family)
actor_attribution.identification_requirement: independently corroborated actor truth; coder string agreement is insufficient

construct_classification.estimand: P(reported observable class | underlying historical claim)
construct_classification.identification_requirement: blind independent coding plus adjudication can estimate coding reproducibility, but source-level construct accuracy requires external corroboration

temporal_error.identification_requirement: events/conditions with independently known timing; publication date is not assumed to equal occurrence date

spatial_error.estimand: distribution of source place error and aggregation mismatch
spatial_error.identification_requirement: independently geolocated claims and a prospectively declared mapping to model localities

source_dependence.identification_requirement: source genealogy/provenance and repeated overlap across independent and dependent pipelines

quantitative_operator_gate: Every empirical record used in estimation is bound to an immutable source-document identity or archived-content hash.
Source-family genealogy is explicit enough to prevent republication/syndication from counting as replication.
There are replicated construct-compatible place/time cells observed through at least two genuinely independent source families.
The replicated cells cover both positive and, where scientifically observable, negative/reference conditions needed for the error component being estimated.
Spatial and temporal observation operators are frozen before inspecting matched Pineland latent values.
Measurement parameters are estimated from source/reference evidence rather than historical predictive fit.
Unidentified error components remain explicit uncertainty terms or are left unestimated.
allowed_if_gate_fails: qualitative or ordinal construct-validity assessment at directly supported source scope
reporting coder agreement and source coverage
forbidden_if_gate_fails: estimating case reporting rates from Pineland fit
treating source non-reporting as a true negative
using article counts as independent replications
historical parameter tuning or core changes justified by the measurement sample
